notes.title: Change to pricing
notes.content:
Due to having the game be 2 years old at this point, I've decided that I will turn the game into a Free-To-Play game per 29th of May. I thank all who bought the game, and hopefully this allows more people to play the game.
Perhaps I'm making a new game soon?
